title: Max Weber's Bureaucracy Explained | Principles of Management Ep 10
description:
Why does a growing business need a rulebook? In this animated lesson, Chai Corner has six people and Ravi dreams of more outlets. But when he steps out, everyone does things their own way. Max Weber's idea of bureaucracy shows him how to fix it.

You will learn who Max Weber was (a German sociologist, 1864 to 1920), what bureaucracy means (clear written rules and a clear chain of command), the 7 features of an ideal bureaucracy: division of labour, hierarchy of authority, formal written rules, impersonality, merit, career and written records, his 3 types of authority (traditional, charismatic and rational-legal), and the good and bad sides of bureaucracy, including red tape.

This is Episode 10 of our Principles of Management series for MBA, BBA and commerce students.

In this video:
0:00 Six people, six ways of working
0:18 Why Ravi needs a rulebook
0:22 Who was Max Weber?
0:45 The 7 features of an ideal bureaucracy
1:27 Three types of authority

2:04 Quick check
2:18 Recap
